name: Fumi Press Launch
description: Fumi Press Launch is an editorial magazine WordPress block theme created for the single-book launch of Clara Hsu's essay collection Small Hours. Designed with a signature framed-window hero, hairline grid borders, and a quiet rikyu-green palette, it presents launch event dates, sample essays, and multiple pre-order editions. Built for Fumi Press, an independent publisher based in Da'an District, Taipei.
